x: Those who were fortunate enough to get in front of the field over the first mile stayed there, and during the whole race the leading men remained the same, Frank Abberton, Bowering (S.L.H.) and Barry (H.H.H.) fighting for first place, Bill Lucas and Marchant being a few places further back.

Walker, our young novice discovery, giving us a good send-off on the first " leg," which he won in the good time of 14min. 55secs. and beat such men as Bowering of S.L.H. and Martin of Surrey, to give us a lead of 9 seconds over the next team.
Len Bishop went next and Bowering of S.L.H. gained 26 secs. on Len but we were still leading and Stan Davies on the next leg gained a little to make the margin in our favour 42 secs.
